card: This PR updates AddrMan's collision selection to filter candidates by reachable networks. Previously, an unreachable tried table address awaiting eviction (such as an Onion peer after switching to -onlynet=ipv4) would be repeatedly selected for feeler testing, failing immediately and stalling all feeler connections for up to 40 minutes. With this change, unreachable collisions are bypassed so that regular feeler connections continue to make progress.
changed_since_previous: No functional changes; the earlier description accurately describes the patch.
evidence: Author encountered the issue in practice after switching a dual-homed (IPv4 + Tor) node to `-onlynet=ipv4`: 'Until then, if it's the only pending collision, no feeler connections are made at all.'
problem: When a node's reachable networks change (for instance, dropping Tor to run `-onlynet=ipv4`), pending collisions involving tried entries on newly unreachable networks can stall feeler connections. Feeler logic prioritizes testing tried collisions, but selecting an unreachable entry fails connection setup and consumes the retry attempts without dialing any peer, blocking all feeler connections for up to the 40-minute `ADDRMAN_TEST_WINDOW`.

risk.why: A logic bug in iterating or filtering tried table collisions could disrupt feeler connections or break eviction defense, weakening eclipse resistance.

summary: Filter tried table collisions in `AddrMan::SelectTriedCollision()` by reachable networks. When testing collisions during feeler connection rounds, the node skips collisions whose existing tried entries are unreachable, falling back to standard feeler connections if no reachable collisions are pending.
